report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV infection started Biktarvy treatment 4 weeks ago. Experiencing severe fatigue, new symptoms, mild nausea as side effect, and significant anxiety and difficulty sleeping that emerged after diagnosis. Adhering to once-daily Biktarvy. Work and daily functioning are substantially reduced - unable to get out of bed some days. Feeling overwhelmed, helpless, and uncertain about the future. Seeking emotional support and coping strategies.

evidence.quote: My chronic illness has been flaring up a lot more than usual, causing severe fatigue and some new symptoms that I'm not used to. It's really affecting my daily life and work
My work, time with family, even just getting out of bed some days is a struggle
It's not just about the physical symptoms either; I'm also dealing with a lot of emotional weight and uncertainty
It's overwhelming and leaves me feeling helpless at times

consequences.reasoning: Patient has lost the ability to get out of bed some days, work is affected, family time is impacted, and they're experiencing emotional turmoil. This represents a major role reduction where they can no longer function independently in daily activities.

They're uncertain about how it's progressing, suggesting they're not fully accepting the chronic nature and are holding both endings open.
